name: Stepper
summary: Shows where the user is in a process with several steps. Built from Step variants (Complete, Current, Upcoming). Compact is the mobile version: a short title above a bar per step.
use: Application flows and forms with 3 to 6 steps.
avoid: Content of the same level: use Tabs.
More than 6 steps: group the steps.
anatomy: Compact: number and title above a bar. No description.
figmaProps: In templates, Orientation is bound to layout-tokens/breakpoint/stepper: Compact at Mobile (xs).
Horizontal, Vertical, Compact / Complete, Current, Upcoming
Three bases, because the layout is different.
Step: Number / Title / Description / Show description / Show connector
Turn Show connector off on the last step.
reactProps: Screen reader text, default 'completed', 'current step', 'to do'.
behaviour: Completed steps with an href are links back.
a11y: The current step has aria-current="step". Each step says its status in text, not only with color.
content: Keep titles to one or two words, so they fit in the compact version on a 320px screen.
do: Let the user go back to completed steps.
dont: Jump ahead to steps that are not ready yet.
